contract: TC-R1 corpus v1; before-outcome asset interface, not execution preregistration

streams.derivation: first eight big-endian SHA-256 bytes of UTF-8 tc-r1-v1|20261007|scene_id|frame_id|replicate|stream
streams.sample_mapping: Track A production interface; seed derivation alone does not freeze sampler dimensions

reference_images: Not present in asset manifest; Track F must bind independent A/B image hashes and convergence before execution freeze
hashing: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 LF file bytes; paths are POSIX repository-relative and must not escape the repository
license: Original procedural scene definitions authored for this repository, SPDX MIT OR Apache-2.0; bind both existing license-file hashes; no external geometry or textures
acceptance: Exactly ten scenes, two variants per family, three fixed frames each; validate strict typed definitions, finite values, admitted feature parameters, deterministic generated bytes and every input hash; no rendering or policy outcomes
